scope: Explicit same-source full CLI artifact repair after retained Cargo debug-stripping ENOSPC. Original Cargo CLI failure is retained; this is a separate full-source relink and isolated CLI smoke, not a claim that the failed original stripping succeeded.

original_failure.version_probe: PermissionError EACCES before process execution; no effect/model/provider call

preservation.scope: Only closed generated noncurrent executables, no live lsof owner, lossless compressed bytes/hash/mode/mtime retained; current dependency libraries/source/private installation state/logs retained.
